spec_provided_observability.name: Mode Register Read (MRR)
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Reads device info (manufacturer/revision/density), operating-mode, refresh, and status mode registers — the primary in-band observability path for an LPDDR5 controller.

spec_provided_observability.name: Read DQ Calibration (RDCAL) / Read FIFO
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Returns a fixed calibration pattern / FIFO contents for read training of the DQ / RDQS sampling phase.

spec_provided_observability.name: Write FIFO
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Loads an internal FIFO for write-path training without writing the DRAM array.

spec_provided_observability.name: WCK2CK synchronization (WS_FS/WS_RD/WS_WR)
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Exercises and observes the WCK-to-CK phase-lock used to validate the high-speed clock path before transfers.

spec_provided_observability.name: Link ECC status
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Read/Write Link ECC can flag corrected single-bit errors on the wire, providing a soft-error observability hook.

spec_provided_observability.name: Per-state IDD specifications
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Defined per-state current consumption points allow board-level power-state observability.

no_jtag_on_DRAM_balls: LPDDR5 SDRAM has no JTAG / boundary-scan pins at the package interface. Vendor DFT for the DRAM die uses wafer-probe scan and BIST that is not visible at the package balls.
controller_side_debug_aids: Logic-analyzer / oscilloscope probing of CK / WCK / RDQS / CA[6:0] / CS / DQ / DMI on the package or interposer.

LPDDR5 PHY / controller IPs expose internal observability — read/write FIFOs, WCK2CK leveling state, per-bit deskew, eye-margin sweeps, DFE tap settings — via a vendor-specific control register interface.
RDCAL fixed calibration pattern used as a deterministic read self-test through the controller PHY.
Link ECC error counters as an in-system bit-error indicator; system-level ECC (controller side) for additional protection.
notes: LPDDR5 SDRAM (JESD209-5) does not specify a formal in-system scan / JTAG / boundary-scan architecture at the DRAM balls. Bus-level observability is limited to mode-register reads (MRR), read/write FIFO and RDCAL training paths, WCK2CK synchronization, Link-ECC status, and IDD power-state measurement; plus controller-side PHY observability and bus probing. Internal DRAM scan / BIST / redundancy repair is vendor-proprietary and out of scope of JESD209-5.
